The instrument sounds by being struck, so watch the placing and the force of the stroke.

The head is animal hide, usually cowhide or goatskin, treated, dried and stretched tight. The bulging middle is carefully carved from wood and strengthens the resonance. The rim and the fittings may be of wood or of simple metal. Some local variants add metal rings or jingles at the edge of the body, which add colour to the timbre and to the look.

桶鼓源於非洲和亞洲的古老鼓樂傳統，是人類最早的打擊樂器之一。在非洲，莫西人的本德: Barrel drums come from the old drumming traditions of Africa and Asia and are among the earliest percussion instruments. In Africa the bendre of the Mossi has been played in what is now Burkina Faso for several hundred years, in religious ritual and social gatherings. In Asia the Vietnamese barrel drum (trong chau) plays an important part in folk music, and its barrel-shaped design produces a deep resonance. As trade routes opened the drum spread gradually through Southeast Asia and developed many local variants. Modern organologists hold that the bulge in the middle comes from practical need, since it makes the drum easy to sling and to play. As the world has grown more connected the barrel drum has not only kept its traditional character but found wide use in contemporary world music and folk orchestras, where it has become an important bridge between the music cultures of East and West.
桶鼓音色渾厚深沉，具有溫潤的共鳴特質。其獨特的桶狀結構使音波能在腔體內充分迴盪，: The barrel drum has a full, deep timbre with a warm resonance. Its barrel shape lets the sound wave reverberate through the cavity, producing a lower middle register that carries. Struck on the head, the tone runs from warm and bright to steady and heavy, with a strong sense of layers. Against a shallow drum's brightness the barrel drum is fuller; against a deep drum's dullness it is more flexible. Its way of resonating is unusual: the bulge in the middle divides the air inside into natural chambers, so the sound wave interferes in complex ways and the instrument takes on a warm, weighty quality of its own. Whether it has one head or two, the barrel drum's resonance creates a warm sound that still has force, and shows a deep cultural character in folk music.
